title: Bias of the constant-pair density
statement: For every integer $n\ge 2$ and real number $\varepsilon<1$, the density uniform on the subspace consisting of the zero vector and the all-ones vector in $\mathbb F_2^n$ is not $\varepsilon$-biased; equivalently, some nonzero vector has a Fourier coefficient with absolute value greater than $\varepsilon$.
